sample_panel.balance: Thirty prompts per count and ten counts per seed.
sample_panel.inference_label: The seed-disjoint registered-confirmation split is reported first, followed by development-conditioned full-panel coverage. Earlier parser and exact-site smokes may have touched individual old-panel prompts, so the split is registered confirmation rather than pristine held-out.

development_selection.nested_membership_audit: PASS: K1, K2, K4, and K6 are exact ordered prefixes of the frozen K8 treatment bank.
development_selection.plan_label: Head ranking uses discovery seeds only. The same frozen ordered bank is applied at p0_item_end across grammar classes; pooled confirmation is the primary inference target.

routing.interpretation: The intervention begins at the previous completed item and remains active through every later cached decode forward.

anchor_registry.sample_flow_rule: All 300 prompts remain in denominator tables; N=1 has no k-to-k+1 transition and is explicitly not applicable.

intervention.selected_arm: Zero K frozen pre-O head slices at p0_item_end and at every later cached decode forward.
intervention.random_control: Three distinct selected-excluded banks with exactly matched selected-head counts per layer.
intervention.endpoint: The first semantic generated city record equals the parser-registered next prompt needle.

execution_matrix.K8: All eligible prompts: shared clean, selected bank, and three layer-matched random repeats.
execution_matrix.K1_K6: Registered-confirmation seeds 1254-1263 only: selected bank and three layer-matched random repeats; reuse the identical K8 clean endpoint by prompt-anchor key.

estimands.confirmation_primary_all_examples: On seeds 1254-1263, selected failure minus mean random failure on paired transitions.
estimands.confirmation_secondary_clean_correct: The same contrast among transitions retrieved correctly by the shared K8 clean arm.
estimands.full_panel_coverage: K8 only, reported as development-conditioned full-panel coverage.
estimands.dose_response: Nested K1, K2, K4, K6, and K8 on registered confirmation; secondary K values reuse the K8 clean arm.
estimands.grammar_specific_k8: Natural-frequency pooled, dominant-grammar-specific, and descriptive rare-grammar results.

inference.hierarchy: At most one selected transition per seed-count prompt; average counts within seed, then weight seeds equally.
inference.bootstrap: Nonparametric seed-cluster bootstrap with 10000 deterministic draws.
inference.test: Two-sided seed-level sign-flip when at least ten seeds support an estimand.
inference.multiplicity: Holm correction across five pooled K tests per endpoint and separately across adequately supported grammar tests.
inference.small_support_rule: Fewer than ten supporting seeds is descriptive or exploratory.

shared_with_non_thinking: raw ranked and raw random arms before contrast
exact sample flow and hash audit
report_contract.separation_rule: Representation geometry is reported separately and is not used as causal evidence.

no_reselection_rule: K values, ordered head membership, p0_item_end routing, registry, matched controls, endpoint, hierarchy, and estimands are frozen before confirmation K-dose execution.
